Research a trending topic in luxury packaging, sustainable B2B packaging, or custom gift box trends for 2026. 
1. Write a SEO-optimized blog post in English for iColorPack (www.icolorpacks.com) in a high-end, professional tone. Include title, meta description, and body.

4. Ensure the content highlights iColorPack's expertise in luxury specialty paper bags and rigid gift boxes (Gold/Black aesthetic, MOQ 500pcs).
